source.epoch: August 1989; about 4 days 20 hours before closest approach
source.filters: green and orange; enhanced display composite, not calibrated RGB albedo
source.nativeDetector: 800 x 800; published enlargement is not native resolution

projection.longitude: relative to the source-facing hemisphere; not IAU absolute longitude

reconstruction.coverageMeaning: geometric source support after conservative taper, not measured weather accuracy
reconstruction.elsewhere: longitude-independent broad OPAL zonal profile, smoothly convergent poles; no invented storms
reconstruction.delighting: robust quadratic fit to log green channel inside 0.78 disc radius; residual source shading remains
reconstruction.calibration: authored natural-colour-informed display balance, not calibrated colour
reconstruction.fineDetail: finite Voyager observations; no procedural noise, no upscaling claim, no portrait pixels
